claims.summary: Characteristic zero, lambda=3/2. For a cluster of M<=4 roots b_i=c_i eps^(v_i) with distinct positive valuations and nonzero c, the pair span's Pluecker coordinate on the columns 0..binom(M,2)-1 has strictly smaller valuation than every other (the caterpillar minimality condition). Hence the caterpillar outer components are unconditional for N<=5, the binary-face components for N<=6, and the near-near and far-far block assumptions of the count formula for clusters of at most four roots.
claims.assessment: Working proof: every minor is divisible by Vand(b)^(M-2) (coinciding row pairs), the Taylor determinant factors exactly for M<=4 (symbolic), and a valuation count.
claims.rationale: Removes the standing minimality hypothesis of the caterpillar line for small clusters.

claims.summary: For roots b_1..b_M and phi_b=(1+bT)^(-3/2), the Taylor determinant at T=0 of the pair products phi_(b_i)phi_(b_j) (columns 0..binom(M,2)-1) equals a nonzero constant times the Vandermonde of the pair sums b_i+b_j, i.e. Vand(b)^(M-2) times the product of b_i+b_j-b_k-b_l over pairs of disjoint pairs.
claims.assessment: Conjecture; exact symbolic factorization for M<=4, degree identity (M-2)binom(M,2)+3binom(M,4)=binom(binom(M,2),2) for all M; M=5 timed out.
claims.rationale: Closed form of the pair-space Taylor determinant; would sharpen the translation lemma and feed minimality for larger clusters.

relationships: Sharpens the nonvanishing to a closed form.
